question.text: Two capacitors $\mathrm{C}_{1}$ and $\mathrm{C}_{2}$ are charged to $120 \mathrm{~V}$ and $200 \mathrm{~V}$ respectively. It is found that by connecting them together the potential on each one can be made zero. Then

solution.text: For potential to be made zero, after connection $120 \mathrm{C}_{1}=200 \mathrm{C}_{2} \quad\left[\because C=\frac{q}{v}\right]$ $\Rightarrow 3 C_{1}=5 C_{2}$
